artworks.title: Flight of Meriones, with Dead Coeranos Being Dragged from the Chariot
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over graphite on laid paper, corners cut
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a chariot and multiple figures engaged in dynamic action. The chariot is pulled by horses, with swirling garments on the figures and flowing mane and muscles on the horses. The figures display expressive gestures, with one figure holding a smaller one. They are positioned around the chariot, seemingly involved in dramatic interaction. The drawing employs ink to emphasize movements and expressions, adding depth and drama to the scene.

artworks.title: Figures Carrying a Body
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures in motion. The drawing is rendered with loose, energetic lines and appears to sketch a scene involving dynamic movement. The figures are captured with minimalistic detail, focusing on form and posture rather than intricate features. The use of lines is expressive, conveying movement and interaction between the figures. The figures are depicted in various poses, some appearing to be in motion while others are in a more static stance.

artworks.title: Standing Man Wearing a Cloak and Hat
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a side view sketch of a standing person. The person is depicted with one leg slightly bent and the other extended forward. They have a beard and are wearing a wide-brimmed hat, a long draped garment with voluminous sleeves, and the clothing appears textured. The person is not holding any objects and the background is a plain light surface. The sketch is done in red chalk on paper.

artworks.title: A Flock of Sheep before a Farmhouse
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a scene from an elevated viewpoint, capturing activity below. The composition includes figures, trees, and a building with expressive, sketchy brushstrokes suggesting movement. In the foreground, a figure walks with sheep and a dog, while people gather near a building in the background. The monochrome palette of grey and black adds a dynamic appearance to the image.

artworks.title: Gleaners
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures moving through a forest or wooded area. The drawing features several figures sketched in loose, flowing lines. On the right side, two figures seem to be walking together while conversing or interacting intimately. Their forms are loosely defined, with elongated limbs and soft contours. In the background, another figure appears in a bent position. The pencil work creates a textured sense of the forest, with vertical strokes suggesting trees surrounding the scene.

artworks.title: Landscape I
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The drawing shows a landscape viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is low in the composition, with hills and a line of trees. The pencil strokes are loose, with horizontal lines in the sky, and curved, dense strokes for trees and hills. A figure sits on a mound in the middle. The color palette is monochrome, using shades of gray to convey the scene, with light and dark areas.

artworks.title: Landscape II
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape sketch viewed from a slightly elevated angle. The scene depicts a textured, earthy terrain leading to distant trees. The horizon is low with vegetation blending into the sky. The sketch is done in pencil or charcoal with loose, hazy strokes. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of grey and brown predominating. The terrain closer to the viewer is more defined, but the overall scene appears blurry with faint outlines of trees and foliage in the distance. On the right, there is a slightly more pronounced vertical stroke indicating a taller tree or structure.

artworks.title: Design for a Vaulted Hall
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural interior. The scene shows a large cathedral or church interior with high, arched ceilings and multiple columns. The perspective captures the structure's grandeur and complexity, showing both upper and lower levels. The arches are prominent, with shadowing and lines emphasizing their depth and curves. This drawing showcases a detailed study of architectural elements, highlighting the play of light and shadow across the stone surfaces. The overall impression is one of architectural splendor and majesty, inviting the viewer to imagine the scale and height of the depicted space.

artworks.title: Stage Design: A Sepulchral Vault
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray washes and watercolor on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a painting of an architectural interior featuring a monumental structure. The scene depicts a grand interior space with towering support beams and architectural elements reminiscent of classical design. Central to the image is a large sculpted pedestal adorned with relief carvings and statues, seemingly placed within an expansive hall or chamber, with the ceiling supported by a series of arches and trusses. Natural or artificial lighting highlights parts of the sculpted figures. The muted color palette and architectural focus suggest an emphasis on the structural majesty of the space. This is in the style of Giovanni Battista Piranesi.

artworks.title: The Triumph of the Trinity (The Gloria)
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a celestial scene featuring various figures arranged in a semi-circular formation. A central pair is above the rest, emitting light. The figures are engaged in different gestures, with some seated and others standing. The drawing includes elements that suggest clouds. The style is soft and subtle, emphasizing movement and interaction between the figures.

artworks.title: Renderings of an Ivory Carving of Ariadne from the 6th Century and an Ivory Plaque from the 9th Century
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite, heightened with white on heavy card
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image contains two intricately carved sculptural pieces. On the left, there is a standing woman figure draped in robes, holding a staff and a round object. Two cherubic figures hover above her, each holding parts of a garland. Her expression is serene, facing slightly to her left. The sculpture features detailed folds in the fabric of her garments. The material seems ivory or cream-colored. At the bottom, a small goat-headed figure is visible. To the right, a rectangular panel displays interwoven scrollwork with smaller human and animal figures engaged in activities. The color and style match the main sculpture. The overall composition suggests ancient or classical themes with detailed ornamentation.

artworks.title: A Saint Holding a Book
artworks.medium: red chalk and brown wash, heightened with white and incised for transfer on wove paper; verso rubbed with red chalk covering a red chalk study of a reclining man seen from behind
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a dynamic stance with one leg bent and one arm resting on a rectangular surface. The figure is facing away from the viewer with long hair flowing down to the neck. They are wearing flowing robes and holding a tablet. The background is a simple textured surface.

artworks.title: Ecclesia Surrounded by Angels Holding the Instruments of the Passion
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over black chalk heightened with white on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring multiple figures in a celestial gathering. A seated figure holds a lantern aloft, surrounded by other figures engaged in conversation. Ethereal beings with instruments fly above. The artwork has detailed linework and shading, showcasing the fluidity of the robes and expressiveness of the figures. The composition captures a scene with a sense of narrative and mystery, common in religious or mythological illustrations.

artworks.title: A Classical Temple
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray, brown, and green washes on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a neoclassical architectural structure. The structure features a grand domed building elevated on a series of broad steps, with tall Corinthian columns supporting an entablature that is decorated with relief sculptures. Above the entablature, there is a balustrade adorned with statues standing at intervals. The building's entrance is centrally located at the top of the stairs, marked by a large arched doorway. The drawing emphasizes symmetry and balance, with a focus on geometric shapes and classical architectural elements such as the detailed columns and sculptural decorations.

artworks.title: Capriccio with a Palladian Villa
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash and watercolor over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a garden path lined with statues and trees. A classical figure statue is close to us on the left. Further down, the path leads to an intricate structure with statues on the roof. The colors are mainly muted earth tones with touches of light blue in the sky.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Shepherds
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over red chalk, heightened with white on laid paper, squared for transfer
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image is a detailed sketch of several figures visible from the waist up. In the center, a seated figure holds a small child, with others gathered closely around. Surrounding the central figures are other people, some kneeling, some standing. Their poses suggest attention and reverence to the central scene. The figures are depicted in various positions, with facial features minimally defined and hair styled differently. The clothing throughout is robes and draped fabric. One figure to the right holds a long staff. The background is a monochromatic, rustic brown wash, with sketchy detailing suggesting an indoor setting, perhaps a stable, with an animal to the left. The ambience is warm and historical with expressive line work capturing a scene.

artworks.title: Ceremony of Consecration
artworks.medium: red chalk over graphite, squared and incised for transfer on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a historical scene with multiple individuals in a columned interior. A central figure is half-kneeling on the ground, surrounded by others standing or sitting around them. The figures are wearing elaborate clothing indicative of a past era. Two individuals stand to the right, with one pointing towards the central figure, and a child is also present. The background features architectural details like tall arches and a decorated wall with circular motifs, suggesting a ceremonial setting. The sketch is outlined in a reddish tone, focusing on form and pose rather than detailed features or color.

artworks.title: Design for a Wall of a Music Room [recto]
artworks.medium: watercolor, gouache, pen and brown ink, and graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a decorative wall panel with a central column adorned with multicolored feathers, greenery, and flowers against a green background. On either side are vertical sections; one features a blue vase under a marble column with intricate designs, and the other displays a green diamond-shaped panel with a sculpted figure. The composition is framed by ornate moldings and decorative bands with gold accents.

artworks.title: Entablature
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate architectural detail. The architectural element features intricate Greco-Roman design elements, including lion heads, floral motifs, and ornamental scrolls. The image primarily shows a cornice or frieze adorned with a series of carved reliefs. Prominent lion heads are positioned on either side of the structure, with stylized acanthus leaves and other classic patterns along the borders. The structure includes columns with decorative elements at their capitals, creating a historical aesthetic akin to ancient architecture. Each element displays elaborate detailing, showcasing a deep appreciation for classical architectural style.

artworks.title: The Flagellation of Christ
artworks.artist: Flemish 17th Century after Hendrik de Clerck
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring figures in an architectural setting. The central figure is bound to a column, with two other figures on each side holding whips or flails. The background shows architectural elements like arches and a dome, creating a grand atmosphere. The drawing uses fine lines and shading for form, texture, and depth. The figures are muscular and dynamic, creating a sense of movement and tension. The architectural details and anatomical accuracy show skilled draftsmanship.

artworks.title: Men Throwing Dice
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows four individuals gathered in front of a decorated tent or canopy. One person stands to the left, facing away from the viewer, dressed in elaborate clothing with a long cloak, doublet, and hose. The second person stands to the right, leaning slightly, and wears an ornate robe. Behind them, two individuals are partially obscured. One is turned toward the person on the right, with finely detailed attire and a headpiece with a veil. All individuals are adorned with draped clothing. The tent or canopy is decorated with floral ornaments, ribbons and bows. In the background, there is an intricately carved or embroidered panel.

artworks.title: The Rescue of Deianeira
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural sketch adorned with figures. The drawing depicts a scene featuring an ornate architectural element, upon which a group of figures is depicted. The figures are in dynamic poses, with one figure reaching upward. The architecture is richly ornamented, with classical elements such as swirls and possibly an empty cartouche or shield at its center. The figures are drawn with fluid lines, capturing movement and the human form. Above the figures are rising plumes or clouds adding to the composition of the scene. The drawing is likely meant to convey a story or represent a mythological scene given the poses and attention to composition.

artworks.title: Stage Design
artworks.medium: pen and gray ink with brown and gray washes over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image displays a grand architectural scene with classical structures, featuring a series of steps leading towards buildings in the distance. The horizon is obscured by towering structures dominating the skyline. The architecture includes arches, columns, and detailed stonework. The artwork appears to be an ink and wash drawing with precise lines and shading. The color scheme is muted and earthy, primarily soft browns and grays. The composition is balanced by steps in the foreground leading towards distant architecture.

artworks.title: Study for an Altar and a Reredos
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate architectural design featuring elaborate Rococo-style embellishments. The design includes decorative columns with Corinthian capitals, curved pediments, and a central arched niche. Flourishing acanthus leaves and volutes frame the structure. The upper portion is adorned with cherubic figures in motion. The drawing showcases a balance between architectural precision and artistic creativity, embodying the elegance and ornamental complexity typical of the Rococo era.
